newsitem.title: USA: Texas Instruments up after report.
newsitem.headline: Texas Instruments up after report.

text.p: Texas Instruments Inc shares surged more than six percent after the Wall Street Journal Wednesday reported that the company is planning to sell its defense electronics holdings worth more than $2 billion.
The report said McDonnell Douglas Corp is one of the interested buyers and cited "people familiar with initial bids offered this week." The sources said the sale could take weeks or months to close.
Texas Instruments rose 3-1/8 to 52-1/8. Company officials declined comment.

A McDonnell Douglas spokesman declined to comment on the report. "We believe there will be further consolidations in the aerospace industry worldwide, but we have not commented on any particular rumors that people have brought to our attention," said spokesman Larry McCracken.
